top_signals.title: Hochstein: Markets Should Be Cognizant of Strike Risk
top_signals.summary: Oil is steadying after a sharp drop as hopes build that the US and Iran could be moving closer to a negotiated settlement. Amos Hochstein, managing partner at TWG Global and a former adviser to President Joe Biden, says markets should remain prepared for the possibility of further strikes even as talks continue. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: PIMCO Says Mideast Crisis Driving High Interest Rates
top_signals.summary:
PIMCO CEO Emmanuel Roman says the ongoing crisis in the Middle East is driving high interest rates. Roman spoke to Yvonne Man and David Ingles on the sidelines of the HKMA Global Financial Leaders’ Investment Summit.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.summary: North Korea rejected allegations linking it to the Binance hack as blockchain researchers traced billions in stolen cryptocurrency across networks.

top_signals.title: BlackRock’s IBIT sees biggest Bitcoin ETF outflows since June
top_signals.summary: BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF shed $405.3 million on Monday as US spot Bitcoin funds opened November with nearly $399 million in net outflows.

top_signals.summary: The plan would allow them to mutually provide information on each other's nationals arrested or detained in their own countries.
